subject: DI04000251

body.en:
Start with the situation

A load at the centre of a bar gives direct stress; the same load offset from the centroid also bends it.

Definition / principle

An eccentric axial loadP at perpendicular offsete is equivalent to a centric forceP plus momentM=Pe at the section.

Understand why

Under a linear-elastic straight-beam model, the normal stresses superpose as sigma=P/A±M/Z at extreme faces.

Application / illustration

The near face may see increased compression while the far face unloads or enters tension.

Common mistake / conditions

Do not apply axialP/A to a transverse bracket load; its direct stress is shear. The FBD decides.

Can one face be tensile under compressive eccentric load?

Yes, when bending overcomes direct compression on that face.
body.gu:
પરિસ્થિતિથી શરૂઆત

Barના centre પર load direct stress આપે;same load centroidથી offset હોય તો bending પણ આપે.

Definition / Principle

Perpendicular offset e પર axial load P sectionમાં centric P અને moment M=Pe equivalent છે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Linear-elastic straight-beam modelમાં extreme faces પર sigma=P/A±M/Z થાય.

Application / ઉદાહરણ

Near faceનું compression વધે,far face unload કે tensionમાં જાય.

Common Mistake / શરતો

Transverse bracket loadમાં axial P/A ન લગાવો;direct stress shear છે.FBDથી નક્કી કરો.

Compressive Eccentric Loadમાં એક Face Tensile થાય?

હા,તે face પર bending direct compressionથી વધે તો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Choose tension-positive or compression-positive and retain it consistently.

Understand why

Compute areaA, centroid, I andZ about the actual bending axis.

Find the signed direct force and bending moment at the chosen cut, not just a load drawn elsewhere.

Add algebraically at each face; check tension and compression against their respective allowables.

For asymmetrical sections, use different extreme distances and section moduli for the two faces.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Tension-positive કે compression-positive પસંદ કરીને consistently વાપરો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Actual bending axis માટે area A,centroid,I,Z ગણો.

Chosen cut પર signed direct force,moment શોધો,ફક્ત elsewhere drawn load નહિ.

દરેક face પર algebraically ઉમેરો;tension/compressionના respective allowablesથી જુઓ.

Asymmetrical sectionમાં બે facesના extreme distances,section moduli જુદાં લો.

body.en:
Given and model

Axial tensile P10kN, e100mm, rectangle b30, h60mm; nominal straight-section model, allowable tension/compression80MPa.

Step-by-step solution

  1. A=30×60=1800mm²; Z=30×60²/6=18000mm³
  2. M=10000×100=1000000Nmm
  3. Direct stress=10000/1800=5.5556MPa
  4. Bending extreme=1000000/18000=55.5556MPa
  5. Face1=5.5556+55.5556=61.1111MPa tension
  6. Face2=5.5556−55.5556=−50MPa(compression)

Common mistake / conditions

Both listed extreme magnitudes are below80MPa in this model; do not claim a strongly curved C-frame is verified by this arithmetic alone.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Axial tensile P10kN,e100mm,rectangle b30,h60mm;nominal straight-section model,tension/compression allowable80MPa.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. A=30×60=1800mm²;Z=30×60²/6=18000mm³
  2. M=10000×100=1000000Nmm
  3. Direct stress=10000/1800=5.5556MPa
  4. Bending extreme=1000000/18000=55.5556MPa
  5. Face1=5.5556+55.5556=61.1111MPa tension
  6. Face2=5.5556−55.5556=−50MPa(compression)

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ modelમાં બન્ને magnitudes80MPaથી નીચે;strongly curved C-frame ફક્ત આ ગણતરીથી verified નથી.

body.en:
Definition / principle

Resolve the clamp force through the frame and cut at the likely critical section.

Understand why

Identify the load line, centroid and actual eccentricity; outside dimensions are not automatically the moment arm.

Select a trial section and calculate direct stress plus bending in the appropriate model.

Check screw/thread loads, jaw contact, fillets, deflection and manufacturing constraints, not only frame stress.

For strongly curved geometry, neutral-axis shift and curved-beam stress can invalidate straight-beamP/A±M/Z; use suitable analysis/standards.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Clamp forceનો frameમાં path શોધી likely critical section પર cut કરો.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Load line,centroid,actual eccentricity શોધો;outside dimension આપમેળે moment arm નહિ.

Trial section લો,appropriate modelમાં direct,bending stress ગણો.

Screw/thread loads,jaw contact,fillets,deflection,manufacture જુઓ,ફક્ત frame stress નહિ.

Strong curvatureમાં neutral-axis shift,curved-beam stressથી straight formula ખોટું પડે;suitable analysis/standards લો.

h.en: 5.1.5 Size an eccentric rectangular member by trial

body.en:
Given and model

P5000N, e60mm, h=2b, allowable maximum tension80MPa; straight-section model.

Step-by-step solution

  1. sigma max=P/(2b²)+3Pe/(2b³)
  2. At b18, h36:sigma max=5000/(2×18²)+3×5000×60/(2×18³)=84.8765MPa(fails)
  3. Select b20, h40:sigma max=5000/800+300000/(20×40²/6)=62.5MPa
  4. Opposite face=6.25−56.25=−50MPa

Common mistake / conditions

The selected section passes the stated nominal tension limit; also verify compression, stability, geometry and stiffness for actual service.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

P5000N,e60mm,h=2b,maximum tension allowable80MPa;straight-section model.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. sigma max=P/(2b²)+3Pe/(2b³)
  2. At b18,h36:sigma max=5000/(2×18²)+3×5000×60/(2×18³)=84.8765MPa(fails)
  3. Select b20,h40:sigma max=5000/800+300000/(20×40²/6)=62.5MPa
  4. Opposite face=6.25−56.25=−50MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

Selected section stated tension limitમાં pass;actual serviceમાં compression,stability,geometry,stiffness પણ જુઓ.

h.en: 5.1.6 Bracket design:axial eccentric vs transverse load
h.gu: 5.1.6 Bracket Design:Axial Eccentric સામે Transverse Load

body.en:
Definition / principle

Not every bracket is loaded in the same direction at its fixing section.

Understand why

An offset axial force gives axial direct stress plus bending; an ordinary horizontal cantilever with vertical end load gives shear plus bending.

At a rectangular section, average transverse shear=P/A and maximum elementary shear=3P/(2A).

Maximum bending normal stress occurs at extreme fibres; maximum transverse shear occurs near the neutral axis. They are not automatically at the same point.

Bolts/welds and base plates need their own group/contact analysis; member stress alone does not size the fixing.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

દરેક bracketના fixing section પર load direction same નથી.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Offset axial forceમાં axial stress+bending;horizontal cantilever પર vertical end loadમાં shear+bending.

Rectangular sectionમાં average transverse shear=P/A,maximum elementary shear=3P/(2A).

Maximum bending extreme fibres પર,maximum transverse shear neutral axis પાસે;બન્ને same point પર આપમેળે નથી.

Bolts/welds,base plates માટે group/contact analysis જોઈએ;member stressથી fixingનું size નક્કી નથી થતું.

body.en:
Given and model

End load2kN at150mm; section b30, h60mm; ignore local concentration for this elementary check.

Step-by-step solution

  1. A=1800mm²; Z=18000mm³; M=2000×150=300000Nmm
  2. Bending extreme=300000/18000=16.6667MPa
  3. Average shear=2000/1800=1.1111MPa
  4. Maximum rectangular shear=1.5×1.1111=1.6667MPa

Common mistake / conditions

There is no axial directP/A normal stress for this FBD; report stresses at their proper locations and use supplied allowables.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

End load2kN,arm150mm;section b30,h60mm;elementary checkમાં local concentration અવગણો.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. A=1800mm²;Z=18000mm³;M=2000×150=300000Nmm
  2. Bending extreme=300000/18000=16.6667MPa
  3. Average shear=2000/1800=1.1111MPa
  4. Maximum rectangular shear=1.5×1.1111=1.6667MPa

Common Mistake / શરતો

આ FBDમાં axial direct P/A normal stress નથી;proper locationsના stresses,supplied allowables લો.

body.en:
Definition / principle

A thrust load offset from a column axis creates direct compression and bending in the simplified column model.

Understand why

Draw machine/head/base reactions; determine the actual section force, offset and unsupported length.

For a hollow round column:A=pi(Do²−Di²)/4, Z=pi(Do⁴−Di⁴)/(32Do).

Compute compressionP/A and bendingPe/Z at opposite extreme fibres; one side can become tensile.

Check buckling/effective length, lateral deflection, base fixity and local stress; the stress formula alone is not a stability assessment.
body.gu:
Definition / Principle

Column axisથી offset thrust simplified modelમાં direct compression,bending આપે.

કારણ સાથે સમજીએ

Machine/head/base reactions દોરો;actual section force,offset,unsupported length શોધો.

Hollow round columnમાં A=pi(Do²−Di²)/4,Z=pi(Do⁴−Di⁴)/(32Do).

Opposite extreme fibres પર compression P/A,bending Pe/Z ગણો;એક side tensile થઈ શકે.

Buckling/effective length,lateral deflection,base fixity,local stress જુઓ;stress formula એકલું stability assessment નથી.

body.en:
Given and model

Compressive P20kN, e100mm, Do80, Di60mm; allowable compression80, tension60MPa.

Step-by-step solution

  1. A=pi(80²−60²)/4=2199.1149mm²
  2. Z=pi(80⁴−60⁴)/(32×80)=34361.1696mm³
  3. Direct compression=20000/2199.1149=9.0946MPa
  4. Bending=2000000/34361.1696=58.2052MPa
  5. Near-face compression=67.2998MPa; far-face stress=9.0946−58.2052=−49.1107MPa(tension)

Common mistake / conditions

Nominal normal stresses pass the separate80/60MPa limits; stability and deflection still need the actual length/support conditions.

Can the far side of an eccentrically compressed column be in tension?

Yes, if bending exceeds the direct compression there.

Is e always the outside arm length?

No. Measure perpendicular offset from centroid to the actual load line.
body.gu:
આપેલી માહિતી અને Model

Compressive P20kN,e100mm,Do80,Di60mm;allowable compression80,tension60MPa.

Step-by-step ઉકેલ

  1. A=pi(80²−60²)/4=2199.1149mm²
  2. Z=pi(80⁴−60⁴)/(32×80)=34361.1696mm³
  3. Direct compression=20000/2199.1149=9.0946MPa
  4. Bending=2000000/34361.1696=58.2052MPa
  5. Near-face compression=67.2998MPa;far-face stress=9.0946−58.2052=−49.1107MPa(tension)

Common Mistake / શરતો

Nominal stresses80/60MPa limitsમાં pass;stability,deflection માટે actual length/support conditions હજી જોઈએ.

Eccentrically Compressed Columnની Far Side Tensionમાં હોઈ શકે?

હા,ત્યાં bending direct compression કરતાં વધારે હોય તો.

e હંમેશાં Outside Arm Length છે?

ના.Centroidથી actual load lineનું perpendicular offset લો.
